definition.simple: How much operating profit a company earns on all the money tied up in it, from lenders and owners.
definition.balanced: In this app: return on capital = operating profit ÷ (debt + equity). Other sources define it slightly differently. A business that earns a high return on capital for years may have a [[competitive-advantage]], but past returns are not promised.

example: Operating profit 156 ÷ (debt 100 + equity 654) = about 20.7% (fictional, millions USD).
